description:
[Servers] Find servers by their map: monuments, counts, size, biomes, land. Online servers whose CURRENT map (drawn from the server's own map file) matches every filter given -
e.g. `monument=Launch Site&monument=Oil Rig&share_biome=snow&share_min=25&size_max=4000`. Each result:
`id`, `name`, `url` (the server page), `connect`, `players`, `max_players`, `country`, and `map`
(`map_key`, `map_size`, `image_url` 480 px, `land_percentage`, `biomes`, `monument_counts`). Servers whose
map isn't drawn yet never match. Same filters as `/servers` and the servers.rustprofit.com list. Cached for
five minutes. Use for 'servers with Launch Site and an Oil Rig', 'small maps with lots of snow', 'custom maps with 2+ oil rigs'. Monuments are names or families: Launch Site, Oil Rig (large or small), Large Oilrig, Military Tunnels, Airfield, Outpost, Bandit Town, Arctic Research Base, Military Base, Underwater Lab, Harbor, Excavator... Only servers whose map is already drawn match. Link each server's url.

count_of.description: With count_min/count_max: how many of this monument (name or family).

country.description: ISO country code of the server.

include_hidden.description: Include servers that Rust's in-game server browser doesn't show (`hidden_in_game: true`); left out by default, like the site's list.

land_max.description: Land at most this % of the map.

land_min.description: Land at least this % of the map.

min_players.description: At least this many players online now.

monument.description: Monument name or family the map must have (`Launch Site`, `Oil Rig`, `Military Base` - see `/servers/monument-types`). Repeat for AND, up to 5.

share_biome.description: With share_min: this biome covers at least share_min% of the land.

name: find_servers_by_map
title: Find servers by their map: monuments, counts, size, biomes, land
